workstreams.name: Legal Framework & Hot Index Context
workstreams.goal: Establish binding legal framework and identify relevant OGH rulings and commentary clusters on maintenance obligations in Wohnungseigentum, especially regarding common facilities and delayed response by management.

workstreams.name: Claim Analysis & Grounding Context
workstreams.goal: Determine actionable claims (Schadensersatz, Erfüllung, Unterlassung) against HV and Eigentümergemeinschaft based on factual scenario and statutory duties, using expert synthesis.

workstreams.name: Immediate Obligation Check (§ 20 Abs 2 WEG)
workstreams.goal: Clarify whether § 20 Abs 2 WEG imposes *immediate* duty on Hausverwaltung to act upon discovery of damage to common property, especially environmental hazard.

synthesis_focus: Whether delayed response by Hausverwaltung to an oil leak in a common facility (allgemeiner Teil) constitutes breach of § 20 Abs 2 WEG, and what civil-law remedies (§ 1318 ABGB, § 28 WEG, § 30 WEG) are available to the affected owner.
